- Added documentation for optional environment variables to configure storage paths and scheduled behavior.
- Noted that all output is printed to stdout, with guidance for agent integration.
- No code changes; this update clarifies configuration and integration details.

- Initial release of Skill Surge Notifier.
- Monitors ClawHub for trending skills based on download and star count metrics.
- Detects surges with configurable thresholds for download growth, total downloads, stars, and top 10 entries.
- Provides commands to fetch stats, check for surges, view status, and manage profile or config.
- Supports relevance scoring and sorting when a user profile is set.
- State tracking and scheduled checks via crontab are supported.
